summary: EShallGo Inc., a Shanghai-based equipment rental and leasing foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering priced August 19, 2026 and closed August 20, 2026. The company sold 800,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share plus pre-funded warrants for up to 950,000 shares at $0.99 per warrant, raising roughly $1.75 million gross before a 7% placement agent fee to Univest Securities and up to $50,000 expense reimbursement. Warrants, exercisable at $0.01, were exercised in full. Proceeds fund working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
